name: Approval Pending PO
query: SELECT 'Purchase Order' AS "Document Type", CONCAT('', po.name, '') AS "Document ID:HTML:120", po.supplier AS "Supplier:Data:150", po.grand_total AS "Total Amount:Currency:120", CONCAT('', po.workflow_state, '') AS "Approval Status:HTML:120", po.status AS "Order Status:Data:120", po.owner AS "Created By:Data:120", po.creation AS "Created On:Datetime:150" FROM `tabPurchase Order` po WHERE po.workflow_state = "Pending Approval"
